effect.name: Portal to Mars
effect.endframe_prompt: Keep the same person with the identical face, hair, skin tone, expression and pose. Change the background to the red dusty surface of Mars with rust-colored dunes and a pale butterscotch sky with two small moons, and change the clothes to a white spacesuit without helmet. Photorealistic cinematic vertical photo.
effect.motion_prompt: The person smiles and snaps their fingers. A glowing red portal ripples open around them and the background dissolves into swirling red dust. The camera pushes in slowly as the dust settles: they now stand on the surface of Mars in a white spacesuit, red dunes and a pale sky behind, and they laugh. Whoosh, wind, a deep cinematic boom.

Plastic click, cardboard thud, a playful jingle.

effect.endframe_prompt: Replace the whole image with a satellite view of planet Earth from orbit at golden hour: Central America and the Pacific coast below thin clouds, city lights starting to glow, a thin blue atmosphere glowing on the curved horizon and black space with stars above. Rushing wind turning into deep space silence.

effect.name: Comic Panel
effect.endframe_prompt: Redraw the same person as a bold comic book hero panel with the identical face, hair and pose: thick black ink outlines, halftone dots, flat bright colors, dynamic speed lines behind and an empty comic speech burst. Vertical comic page.
effect.motion_prompt: The person punches the air toward the camera. On impact the whole frame cracks into ink lines and halftone dots, colors flatten into bold comic tones, speed lines burst behind them and the final pose freezes as a comic book panel. A cartoon punch sound, paper rustle, an upbeat sting.
